{{Quote|I've been here before, to the Razor. Nothing good lives here.|[[Senya Tirall]]|<ref name="KotFE 7" />}}
The '''Razor ''' was a location in [[District 1327|Breaktown]] on [[Zakuul]]. During the [[Eternal Empire conquest]] it became a headquarters of the information broker known as [[SCORPIO|The Lady of Sorrows]]. In [[3631 BBY]], the Lady kidnapped [[Brennen]], the son of the [[Heralds of Zildrog]] leader [[the Exalted]] and demanded him to come to the Razor. The Exalted brought many of his fellow Heralds with him, but all of them were killed except Brennen, who was ordered to lead the Heralds in the Lady's name.<ref name="KotFE 7" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Razor appears as an area on Zakuul during "Chapter 7: The Lady of Sorrows" of the ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' expansion.<ref name="KotFE 7" />
